verdicts.rationale: REST v2 API accepts shardsNum=0 and shardsNum=-1 with HTTP 200, violating explicit constraint 'shardsNum >= 1' (milvus_range_collections_create_002). Source code confirms: handler_v2.go parses shardsNum without lower-bound validation; createCollectionTask.validate() only checks upper bounds. API silently defaults invalid values to 1, returning success. This is a true validation defect in the REST v2 layer, consistent with developer cognition pattern 'REST v2 data type handling' (25+ similar issues).
